high_level_description: This image is a newspaper front page from The New York Times dated Tuesday, May 5, 1970. The headline reads "4 Kent State Students Killed by Troops," which is the central focus of the page. Below the headline is a black-and-white photograph depicting a dramatic scene. In the foreground, a student is kneeling on the ground, appearing to be in distress or shock, with their arms outstretched. Behind them, several individuals, including what appear to be soldiers or guards, stand in a line, some holding weapons. The background shows an outdoor setting, possibly a campus or public area, with trees
